Final for Publication

TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS
2739-45 W. Belmont Ave.

The Applicant seeks to rezone 2739-45 West Belmont Avenue from a M1-1 Limited
Manufacturing/ Business Park District to a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District. The
property is improved with an auto-body shop and a three-unit residential building at
2739-41 W. Belmont and a two-unit residential building at 2745 W. Belmont. The
Applicant seeks to rezone the property to divide the zoning lot. The Applicant seeks to
preserve the existing three-flat at 2741 W. Belmont, to preserve the existing two-flat at
2745 W. Belmont, and to demolish the auto-body shop to construct a residential building
at 2739 W. Belmont with six (6) dwelling units and three (3) parking spaces. The height
of the proposed building will be 46 feet. No commercial space will be provided.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks variation relief for the new
building at 2739 W. Belmont to reduce the rear setback to 25 feet pursuant to Section 17-
13-1101-B. Moreover, the Applicant seeks an administrative adjustment to increase the
parking by 100% for 2741 W. Belmont pursuant to Section 17-13-1003-EE. Lastly, the
Applicant is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning
Code, for the attached plans.
